body: Also these ones and the others in the nodes branch, they don't include the counter in the string.

```suggestion
	undo_redo->create_action_for_history(TPL(instances.size() == 1, TTR("Instantiate Scene"), TTR("Instantiate Scenes")), editor_data->get_current_edited_scene_history_id());
```
Same with the other one in this file.

Or ` == 1` can be part of the macro, since it always needs it and makes using it shorter.

This one was missed.

Also the one in `editor\file_system\dependency_editor.cpp`:
`  463: 			file_options->add_icon_item(get_editor_theme_icon(SNAME("Load")), TTRN("Open Scene", "Open Scenes", selected_items.size()), FILE_MENU_OPEN);`

```suggestion
				"\n" + vformat(TPL(files.size(), TTR("Hold %s: Add @export var pointing to the resource."), TTR("Hold %s: Add @export vars pointing to the resources.")), keycode_get_string((Key)KeyModifierMask::ALT));
```
This hardcodes alt and tries to pass it to vformat.
- related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121489
